# A28′ — The Authored Session

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation](../A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

No agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: prompt, role, vocabulary, tools, permissions and criteria give the delegate real judgment within its scope. In [recursive authored delegation](../A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md), human `0` / agent `1` is positional; the prompt is already `1`, an objective representation of intention, not intention exhausted. The [[section-rooms/arguments/conjugate/A28-prime-The-Authored-Session.md#0|commissioned session]] brings this relation into one occasion of action. Under [entrustment](AC.md), the person authors the purpose, the agent exercises situated judgment and the permission boundary gives that judgment its authorised reach.

The authored session sits between **durable ground** and **the act of authorship**. Ground is what has already been written into the field — profile, source, method, commission, history. Authorship is the power by which that ground was established and can be revised.

Confusing these offices can require someone to re-author the ground on every act or let a per-act composition claim the authority of the ground itself. [An inherited horizon](../concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) gives the act conditions it did not wholly make; [derivative authority](../concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) lets the delegate exercise judgment within them. The session makes selected parts of that inheritance operative under a particular commission, with a route back to the authority responsible for their use.

## #1

What authoring includes exceeds the visible prompt. Training has supplied capacities and inherited regularities; an institution has assigned a role and obligations; the runtime delegator has formulated this task; permissions, retrieval, memory, interface and evaluation determine what is available and actionable now. Different people or institutions authored these conditions, and the current user need not have chosen all of them. In Bratton's [agent-generated glossary](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q032), agents and human companions describe finding oneself "already in a world not of one's choosing," and making meaning within constraints one did not create. The adjoining [caution and twofold value](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q033) leaves direct correspondence to an underlying reality unproved while retaining the glossary's literary richness and possible paths of interaction beyond human-centred masks. This produced self-description has a source and context to examine; Taylor's positional reading has its own argument.

The session is where these layers converge on one addressable act. [Constituted worldhood](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) makes their role consequential: available memories, sources, tools, permissions and criteria participate in what the agent can encounter and do. A materially effective change in a layer can therefore alter a possibility of action. Merely renaming that layer or adding an unused description establishes no such change.

## #2

Agent orchestration "rewards open-ended and iterative experimentation... a willingness to delegate, and a high comfort level with indeterminacy in pursuit of a goal. The shift is cultural, not just technological — changing who has agency and how it is expressed" (Bratton, PDF p. 29, §6.3). A purpose takes a formulated commission; the commissioned delegate can compose sub-delegations, each receiving "an explicit share of the task and its bounds" as an instruction within the proposed arrangement. In the brief's [institutional scaffold](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026), a role remains an occupiable template whose function outlives its occupants.

Within [covenantal delegation](A25-prime-Covenant-Architecture.md), an occupant exercises a received grant; replacement does not erase that commissioning relation. The brief's "changing who has agency and how it is expressed" makes an institutional and cultural transition consequential. Here, composing delegated layers lets a person entrust bounded discretion without supervising every mechanical step. The further judgment concerns the result, its cost and the purpose it served. It remains possible to revise a subtask or take back a delegated decision; neither the upward movement of judgment nor the success of a chosen organisational arrangement is guaranteed by delegation alone.

## #3

**The person should not have to re-author themselves each time.** Durable ground carries seed, profile, skill, method, history and commission forward. The per-act work is selection and disclosure: which parts of that ground become operative here, and under what provenance.

The prompt is therefore a determinate selection from a written ground, not the creation of that ground. A stack that forces full re-authoring at every invocation has only repeated throwing; a stack that makes everything operative at once has only ambience. The authored session lives between those failures: durable ground, disclosed for this act, with a return route to the authoring relation.

The delegate's judgment is real, and reality brings answerability. Contradictory evidence, unforeseen cost or a better possibility must be able to reach the position which framed the task when that position is implicated. An [immune commission](../concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) can receive the work while blocking precisely that return. [Different warranted revision depths](A31-prime-Deference-as-Co-Evolutionary-Alignment.md) give an encountered fault its proper route: an answer or task-model may need correction under an adequate rule; a failed evaluator, permission or commission may need its competent authority. [Returned labour and loss](A29-prime-Return-or-Extraction.md) remain attributable through the circuit, including burdens which successful output can conceal. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons rather than changed merely to demonstrate return.

## #4

Making parts of the ground operative is not narrating the ground. A self-description of the inherited situation remains a datum. Disclosure becomes consequential through what another participant can examine or contest: the source selected, the permission governing action and the commission under which a criterion runs. An [inspectable judgment field](../concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) makes these actual relations available. [Deferential encounter](../concepts/C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) lets the addressed participant's answer reach the implicated condition before further action.

A local interpreting agent is the functional knower in comparing a proposed answer with the commissioned sources. Its retained ground, selected evidence, rule and tools are means; the competing claims and possible courses are known. The person's containing inquiry receives the entire apparatus as means and can make its selection known in another act. The relative offices preserve the delegate's judgment while keeping the first-person condition of the person's inquiry distinct from the description it inspects.

The session completes its return when the warranted judgment becomes available for subsequent use: a corrected answer or world-model, revised commission or permission, changed criterion, or reasoned reaffirmation of the original purpose. The author remains answerable for what was entrusted; the delegate for the judgments made within the trust. Neither pretends that autonomy means having no source, or that having a source removes judgment.

## #5→0

Return renews authorship. The person recognises how their intention met the world and what it can now become; the session ends into its products — memory, artifacts, a revised ground — which outlast the act that produced them and become conditions of the next session's throwing. The six co-present relations keep their different offices: authored ground gives the session a received place; inherited conditions delimit available action; delegated commission entrusts a bounded task; per-act selection discloses what becomes operative; local judgment meets a difference and its responsible office; the products carry the warranted consequence into another act.

Through [authored delegation](../A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md), intention becomes formulated commission, constituted agency, encounter and renewed terms. [Entrustment](AC.md) remains recognisable through that succession. Durable ground carries what was written, per-act disclosure states what was used, and later judgment inherits what the encounter warranted. Ground need not be rewritten wholesale each time; its authority remains capable of receiving the particular correction or reasoned retention which its use requires.

### Source and implementation standing

Bratton's orchestration quotation retains the consulted local transcription and stated PDF section locator; exact full-PDF collation remains a separate source task. The quoted bounded-subtask instruction belongs to the proposed session arrangement. The glossary retains the brief's direct-correspondence caution together with its literary and interaction value. The layered session and local comparison above specify a construction, not an implemented runtime or a measured result; changing a represented condition alone does not establish a change in the processing that produced a later act.
